stem.text: Two bodies travelling along the same straight line collide in a perfectly elastic collision.

A.text: The initial speed of one body will be the same as the final speed of the other body.

B.text: The relative speed of approach between the two bodies equals their relative speed of separation.

C.text: The total momentum is conserved but the total kinetic energy will be reduced.

D.text: One of the bodies will be stationary at one instant.
